subject: Hosted evaluation — traffic profile, rate limits, and quickstart
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Grant <sophie.grant@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted evaluation — traffic profile, rate limits, and quickstart

Hi Sophie — thanks again for taking the demo yesterday. Quick recap and a few asks so we can scope a short hosted evaluation for Acme Retail.

Summary of our conversation (high level):
- You want to validate a product-search assistant (ranking + generation) that will be embedded in the web storefront and mobile app.
- Initial pilot target: US region, read-heavy (search and embeddings) with occasional conversational flows.
- Primary concerns: latency under 200ms p50, predictable cost, and secure handling of order-related PII.

To scope a Hosted evaluation we need: (please reply inline with the numbers where possible)
1) Traffic profile: expected peak concurrent requests, avg req/s, and typical token lengths for your prompts/responses. A simple example: 150 req/s peak, avg 32 tokens in prompt, 120 tokens response.
2) Evaluation goals: accuracy metrics you care about (e.g., top-5 rerank CTR lift, generative answer F1, or manual QA rubric).
3) Any compliance requirements (data retention window, SOC2 specific evidence, IP allowlist).
4) Who should receive the test credentials (email addresses) and the preferred start window (we can provision test credentials within 2 business days).

Quickstart we can provide (Hosted):
- Temporary test API key (2-week window) and a sandbox endpoint with a 60 req/s default limit, 120 req/s burst.
- Streaming and non-streaming endpoints: https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/generate and /v1/embeddings.
- Example curl and SDK snippets, plus a short walkthrough PDF (attached).

Note on deployment modes (so we’re explicit):
- Hosted API: fastest to run — no infra on your side, predictable provisioning for the pilot, shared control plane but isolated customer data paths.
- Dedicated: reserved GPU pools if you need sustained high throughput or stricter tenancy SLA.
- Private (VPC / on-prem): for air-gapped or strict network controls — longer lead time for setup.

Proposed next steps:
- Sophie/Tom: send traffic snapshot (CSV or approximate numbers) and the list of evaluation prompts by EOD Friday.
- We’ll provision a sandbox API key and a short mutual action plan (MAP) that lays out success criteria and timeline.
- Quick sync (15–20m) next week to confirm config if needed.

Attaching: redwood-hosted-quickstart.pdf (quick steps), sample rate-limit policy, and a template for the traffic snapshot.

Thanks — Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Sophie Grant <sophie.grant@acmeretail.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acmeretail.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted evaluation — traffic profile, rate limits, and quickstart

Karthik — thanks for the clear summary. Quick answers inline below.

1) Traffic profile (current prod search traffic, approximate):
- Average: 45 req/s (search + embeddings combined)
- Peak (Black Friday-style bursts): ~380 req/s for short periods (~5–10 mins)
- Typical prompt/response size: prompts ~20–60 tokens (search queries + product context), generative responses ~80–220 tokens for detailed answers.

2) Evaluation goals:
- Rerank: improve top-1 CTR by 6–8% on personalized searches
- Gen quality: manual QA rubric target score >= 4/5 on accuracy and hallucination checks for answers related to product availability and sizing

3) Compliance: SOC2 is table-stakes; we’ll need evidence for data retention (default 30 days), and an option to opt into longer retention for debug logs. PII must be redacted before sending to any hosted service if possible.

4) Please send the test credentials to me and Tom (tom.alvarez@acmeretail.com). Best start window: next Monday (June 15).

A couple other quick questions:
- Can the hosted sandbox handle short high bursts like the 380 req/s we described?
- What are the per-minute token limits?

Appreciate it — Sophie
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Grant <sophie.grant@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted evaluation — traffic profile, rate limits, and quickstart

Thanks Sophie — great details, that helps a lot. Answers and what we’ll provision for the pilot below.

Burst handling / rate limits:
- Sandbox hosted tier we’ll provision: 120 req/s steady with a burst allowance to 450 req/s for short windows (up to 10 minutes) — should cover your 380 req/s bursts.
- Token throughput: default hosted throttle is set at 1.8M tokens/minute for the sandbox. If you need more, we can enable higher token buckets for the dedicated test window (requires a short capacity review).
- Concurrency: p50 latency targets are maintained at <200ms for text-generation endpoints under the quoted limits; we’ll monitor telemetry during the eval and adjust if needed.

Security / compliance notes:
- SOC2: we’ll provide the SOC2 report and the standard hosted evidence package.
- Retention: sandbox default 30 days (logs/requests); we can offer a custom retention policy for debugging in a dedicated trial.
- PII: recommend redaction at the app layer. If you need assistance, our Solutions Engineering team can run a short redaction checklist with you.

What we’re provisioning for the June 15 start (timeline):
- Test API key for Sophie and Tom (2-week sandbox, renewable)
- Sandbox endpoints: https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/generate (streaming supported) and https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/embeddings
- Rate limits: 120 req/s steady, 450 req/s burst (10 min), 1.8M tokens/minute
- Access to a small sandbox dashboard with token/latency charts and per-route breakdowns

Quickstart snippets (curl + SDK):
- curl (generate):
  curl -X POST https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/generate 
    -H "Authorization: Bearer TEST_KEY_xxx" 
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
    -d '{"model":"rwd-small-2026","prompt":"<user prompt>","max_tokens":150}'

- embeddings:
  curl -X POST https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/embeddings 
    -H "Authorization: Bearer TEST_KEY_xxx" 
    -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-001","input":["product title","product description"]}'

Attachments we included: redwood-hosted-quickstart.pdf (setup checklist + example app), and a small traffic-snapshot template (we pre-filled with your approximate numbers and attached acme-traffic-snapshot.xlsx).

Next steps:
- I’ll send credentials to you & Tom on Monday morning (June 15) and confirm the sandbox is live.
- Marissa will schedule a 20-min check-in on June 17 to walk through telemetry and a quick tuning checklist.
- Please upload a short set (20–30) of representative prompts and expected outputs to the HubSpot file link above or reply by email.

If anything changes on the traffic estimates, flag it ASAP so we can tweak the burst bucket.

Best — Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
